faqs_description1: FMX is a full-service solution for your business. Our program has been coded and written specifically for the Japanese wholesale market. We have not adopted any other software or program. The platform provides continual innovation through streamlining transactions and end-to-end communication to facilitate the distribution of fresh produce through your business.
faqs_description2: Our specialised industry Team will show you how to use the platform as well as assist with all on boarding requirements to help transition your business making it more efficient for you. Our platform is easy to use with tablets and computers and simple functions.
faqs_description3: We charge a flat fee of 330,000Y per month for the platform. This fee covers inventory management, Pont of Sale, Online Ordering, Analytics and Insights, and full support. Most future upgrades and changes are also covered and included in the monthly fee.
faqs_description4: Yes; you can export information into pdf, Accounting, and other software. If there is a specific need that you have please email us so we can assist your business.
faqs_description5: We are from the Wholesale industry so we understand the needs of each business and the customer. We have created a program that simplifies trading in the Market and makes the process more efficient.
faqs_description6: We have support online and a team in the Market to assist you. We can look into any issue you have to help your business going forward.
